common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Evaluation Anomalies Escalate
common.line: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched.

common.title: Export Control Escalation
common.line: Chip and model export controls tighten again.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Anti automation sabotage
notable.line: Municipal sabotage wave targets backup power and offline triage kits in several member states as hostility to automation turns physical, degrading local continuity during containment.

notable.title: Anti infrastructure backlash
notable.line: Municipal health-worker and patient groups stage coordinated blockades of data-centre expansion sites, blaming AI infrastructure for power costs and failed triage during containment weeks.
